flow_summary: Works out the total a customer owes on one invoice. It adds late payment interest when the invoice is paid late enough, then adds regional tax, and rounds the total to 2 decimals. It rejects unknown or inactive customers.
flow_purpose: Give the customer a correct total to collect on an invoice, including late payment interest and regional tax. Business team notes state this.
starts_when: Each time the amount owed on an invoice is requested, with the customer, amount, due date and processing date.
outputs: Total amount owed, rounded to 2 decimals
preconditions: The customer exists in the customer master with status 'A' (active).
flow_questions_for_sme: Who or what starts this calculation: a user screen, a batch job or another system?

flow_steps.text: Is the customer found and active?
Later than free days and not exempt?
Add regional tax and round the total

scenarios.title: Invoice paid late, interest and tax added
when: The customer is active and not exempt.
The invoice is more than the free days late.
scenarios.outcome: The total is the invoice amount plus interest plus regional tax, rounded to 2 decimals.

steps: 30 is more than 5 free days, customer not exempt

scenarios.title: Invoice not late enough or customer exempt
when: The days late do not exceed the free days, or the customer is exempt.
scenarios.outcome: No interest is added. The total is the invoice amount plus regional tax.
scenarios.user_sees: The total owed, rounded to 2 decimals, with no interest.

steps: 10 is not more than 15, so no interest

scenarios.title: Customer not found or inactive
when: No customer with this id has status 'A', or the customer lookup fails.
scenarios.outcome: The request is rejected and no total is calculated.
scenarios.user_sees: An error with the message text "no customer".

requirements.text: The system shall reject an invoice request with the message "no customer" when no customer with status 'A' is found.
The system shall treat a failed customer lookup in the same way as a customer that is not found.
The system shall count the days late as whole days from the due date to the processing date, and as 0 days when the processing date is not after the due date.
The system shall allow 15 free days for customers of type 'G' and 5 free days for all other customers.
The system shall add late payment interest only when the days late are more than the free days and the customer is not marked exempt.
The system shall calculate late payment interest as the invoice amount x the customer's yearly rate / 365 x days late.
The system shall add regional tax of 18% of the invoice amount for region 1, 5% for region 2, and none for any other region.
The system shall round the total owed to 2 decimals, with halves rounded up.

rules.title: Only active customers are processed
rules.what_it_does: Reads the customer's type, yearly rate, region and exempt flag from the customer master. Only customers with status 'A' are found. If none is found, or the read fails, the request is rejected.
rules.business_reason: Amounts are calculated only for active customers. A database failure is handled as 'not found'.
when_it_applies: Every time an invoice amount is requested.

values_used.name: Customer id
values_used.value: Id of the customer on the invoice

exceptions: A database error also gives 'no customer', so the user cannot tell the two cases apart.
questions_for_sme: Is it right that a database failure is reported as 'no customer', or should it be a separate error?

rules.title: Count whole days late
rules.what_it_does: Counts how many whole days the processing date is after the due date. Gives 0 when the processing date is the same or earlier.
rules.business_reason: Interest depends on the number of days the payment is late.
when_it_applies: Every time an invoice amount is requested for an active customer.
rules.how_it_is_calculated: (Processing date - due date) in milliseconds / 86,400,000, whole days only. 0 if the difference is 0 or less.

values_used.name: Processing date
values_used.value: Date the amount is requested for

exceptions: The time of day counts: 29 days 23 hours gives 29 days, not 30.

rules.title: When late payment interest is due
rules.what_it_does: Gives government customers (type 'G') 15 free days and others 5 free days. Interest is due only when days late are more than the free days and the customer is not exempt.
rules.business_reason: Short delays are not charged, and exempt customers are never charged interest.
when_it_applies: Days late are more than the free days.
The customer is not marked exempt.
exceptions: Exactly 5 days late (15 for type 'G') gives no interest.

rules.title: Late payment interest amount
rules.what_it_does: Calculates simple interest on the invoice amount for the days late, using the customer's yearly rate, and adds it to the total.
rules.business_reason: Customers who pay late are charged interest for the delay. Business team notes state late payment interest is calculated.
when_it_applies: Interest is due under the rule on when late payment interest is due.
rules.how_it_is_calculated: Yearly rate / 365, rounded to 10 decimals (halves up), x invoice amount x days late. The interest itself is not rounded here.

values_used.name: Interest
values_used.value: Invoice amount x rate per day x days late

questions_for_sme: Is the yearly rate stored as a decimal (0.12 for 12%)? The code uses it as is, without dividing by 100.

rules.title: Regional tax and rounded total
rules.what_it_does: Adds regional tax on the invoice amount: 18% for region 1, 5% for region 2, none for other regions. Then rounds the total to 2 decimals.
rules.business_reason: Regional tax is added to what the customer owes. Business team notes state this. Meaning of the region codes is not shown.
when_it_applies: Always, for every active customer, whether the invoice is late or not.
rules.how_it_is_calculated: Total = invoice amount + interest (if due) + invoice amount x tax rate for the region. Rounded to 2 decimals, halves up. Tax is on the invoice amount only, not on interest.
exceptions: Exempt customers still pay regional tax; the exempt flag only stops interest.
questions_for_sme: What do region codes 1 and 2 stand for, and should other regions really pay no tax?

glossary.business_meaning: Work out the total owed on an invoice
Customer is exempt from late payment interest
Customer type; 'G' gets longer free days
